name: Kokuritsu Kidou Sentai RIPS V
original_name: 国立機動戦隊 RIPS V
source:
The Earth is being targeted.
Fight the invaders, RIPS!
A masterpiece of silly games created in the early 1998s.
From the story to the setting, it was a complete idiot game!
(words of praise).
translation:
地球正成为攻击目标。
对抗入侵者，RIPS！
20世纪98年代初创作的傻瓜游戏杰作。
从故事到设定，完全就是一个白痴游戏！
（赞美的话）。
